description: Step 1 of registering (or logging in) a user with a wallet keypair — no browser needed. Returns a challenge message to sign with the wallet's private key. Works for Solana (base58 Ed25519 address) and EVM (0x address). Follow with auth_wallet_verify. New wallets are auto-registered on first verify as a free account (a daily allowance + 3 runs; the Studio, $249 a month, lifts the caps).

chain.description: optional chain override (solana | evm) — auto-detected from the address

wallet_address.description: the wallet's public address (base58 Solana or 0x EVM)

wallet_type.description: defaults by address shape: 0x → metamask, else phantom

name: auth_wallet_challenge
title: Start wallet registration / login
